title: butneria florida
intro: Butneria florida, commonly known as the Red Sandalwood, is a plant species native to tropical forests of India and Sri Lanka. This plant is valued for its wood, leaves, and roots, which have been used in traditional medicine for centuries due to their health benefits. The health benefits of Butneria florida include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help in reducing pain, inflammation, and improving overall health. The bioactive constituents of Butneria florida include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as analgesic, antipyretic, and anti-inflammatory effects.
